details.fixtureGameFiles: hardlinks used only for read-only identity checks; corruption cases unlink before writing

installer.scope: Real shipped scripts and launcher in isolated fixtures; actual published 0.5.0-r2 and 0.5.1 upgrades/recoveries. No game-process mocks.

native.scope: NGX evaluate/output readback, dimensions, repeated init/shutdown, state restoration; exact DXGI proxy ordinary presentation, resize and release. Explicit standalone probe mode; gameplay FG modes are checked separately.

gameplay.playerPerformanceObservation: Without frame generation, player reported approximately 60-70 FPS in front of their shop after the game update; previously lower in their video. Uncontrolled observation, not a NightShift 0.5.2 benchmark.
gameplay.scope: Player visual and mode-switch smoke check plus fresh startup/render logs; no controlled FPS or physical presentation benchmark.

limitations: Player smoke check on RTX 5070, 2560x1440; no controlled FPS or physical presentation benchmark.
The reported 60-70 FPS after the game patch is an uncontrolled player observation, not a measured NightShift gain.
Broader hardware, long sessions, scene transitions and moving-object/UI quality remain under review.
The previously observed Unity shutdown fault is not claimed fixed by this release.
